query: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN p.price > (SELECT AVG(price) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cat_nm) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category = c.category AND p.ref_id = c.ref_id WHERE c.cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND p.price > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category = c.category AND p.ref_id = c.ref_id WHERE c.cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND p.price > 0), 0)), 2) AS percentage_above_average FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category = c.category AND p.ref_id = c.ref_id WHERE c.cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND p.price > 0
